# Bundled Browser Dependencies

No npm install, CDN or network requests are required at runtime.

- Three.js 0.164.1: three.module.min.js, OrbitControls.js, STLLoader.js.
  https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.164.1.tgz
  MIT license in LICENSE. Used for URDF transforms, STL loading and rendering.
- Lucide 1.8.0: lucide.min.js. https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
  License in LUCIDE-LICENSE. Used for interface icons.

These files are upstream distributions, not locally reimplemented libraries.
